jobDescription:
Product Engineering Intern, Applied AI
BrightPath Careers

About the role
BrightPath Careers is building AI-powered workflow software that helps students discover roles, tailor application materials, and prepare for interviews with grounded career intelligence.

What you'll do
- Build polished full-stack product experiences with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
- Collaborate with product, design, and AI teams to launch user-facing agentic workflows.
- Improve retrieval quality, source grounding, and explainability in AI-generated outputs.
- Design experiments, measure quality, and ship quickly in a startup environment.

Requirements
- Experience building web applications with modern JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks.
- Comfort with APIs, backend services, and data modeling.
- Familiarity with LLM products, RAG systems, or prompt engineering.
- Strong product sense and communication skills.

Nice to have
- Experience with Firebase or cloud services.
- Experience shipping hackathon projects or startup prototypes.
- Interest in career mobility, education, or recruiting technology.
